_doc: AGENT GitHub App manifest: the identity LLM coding agents run as (claude-code-action jobs). Deliberately narrow: it can push branches, open PRs and comment, but cannot touch workflows, settings or rulesets, and its comments are never trusted as protocol (squadhq.untrusted.by_agent). Created alongside the ops App by `squadhq init --create-app` unless --single-app. Same placeholders as app-manifest.json.

_permissions_rationale.contents: write: Push feature branches. The ruleset requires a PR with one approval from someone other than the last pusher, so the agent can never land code by itself.
_permissions_rationale.pull_requests: write: Open and update PRs, reply to review threads. Its own approval never satisfies the ruleset (require_last_push_approval).
_permissions_rationale.issues: write: Comment on tickets in role ([Engineer], [Product Owner] ...) and apply the labels label_guard allows its role.
_permissions_rationale.checks: read: Read CI results to fix failing builds.
_permissions_rationale.not requested: workflows (an agent can never edit .github/workflows), administration, actions, actions_variables, secrets, members, organization_projects: all ops-only or human-only.

name: __APP_NAME__
description: Agent Squad HQ coding agents. Pushes branches and opens PRs; cannot merge, approve its own work or edit workflows.
